dispatch_order: Both equal-ID calls dispatched before killing A and before observing any unknown result; B contended with the existing durable claim. No write dispatched after unknown.
followup: Read original operation_status or perform remote read-only verification; preserve intent and all receipts. No cleanup write after unknown.
limitations: This exercises one actual after-intent process-crash window, not every deterministic fault-injection window.
HTTP mutation counts are not externally instrumented; two stdio calls are not two HTTP calls.
Killing A closes its real SDK connection, but does not isolate an SDK-only disconnect from a process crash.
